nota: Volátil (contorno de hoje). Classe dos vizinhos: 14 pontos de amostra dos dois lados da faixa (sin-03): Gardena 2, Carson 2, Torrance 3, Lomita 1, terra do condado 6; Long Beach em nenhum (fica a 2,08 mi).
narracao: The city had owned a coast for almost three years before the wall was done. Look at the outline today. The city covers about 469 square miles. And the strip is still there, about half a mile wide. On today's outline, the city has grown around both ends, and about nine miles of it still run thin, between other cities and county land.
